## phr-p03-v11 — argument map

Sūtra 9: like consciousness, impure by tightened power — a wanderer. Sūtra 10: yet likewise does the five acts (creation/keeping/loosing/veiling/blessing). Sūtra 11-12: those doings are wanderinghood.

### Open
- Five acts standard Trika (cf. Bodhavilāsa, Paramārthasāra); śaktisaṃkoca unspecified (citi→citta via māyā).
